# Acme Corp — Azure AI Strategy

## Executive Summary

Acme Corp's infrastructure signals point to a Microsoft Azure footprint, making
Azure AI services the natural extension of the existing stack. (Reported) [cite: 1]

What to validate: confirm the Azure footprint with the platform team. [cite: 1]

## Current State

The estate is predominantly Azure App Service and Azure DNS. (Reported) There is
no disclosed AI strategy, but recent hiring skews toward ML engineering. (Estimated) [cite: 2]

What to validate: confirm whether an internal AI initiative is already underway. [cite: 2]

## Recommendations

Begin with Azure AI Foundry for retrieval-augmented workflows on existing data,
then expand to agentic automation once governance is in place. (Hypothesis)

What to validate: confirm data-governance readiness before agentic rollout. [cite: 1]

## Implementation Roadmap

A phased rollout over three quarters balances quick wins against governance risk. (Estimated)

What to validate: confirm budget and owner for each phase with the sponsor. [cite: 2]

## Risks and Mitigations

Primary risks are data governance and change-management capacity. (Hypothesis)

What to validate: confirm change-management capacity with the program office. [cite: 1]
